name: Grimoire: Clank Lorebook Importer
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3
desc: A custom extension for clank.world that turns bulk lorebook entry into a small ritual. Drop structured .md or .txt files and Grimoire provisions, fills, and saves dozens of memory entries automatically — using Chrome DevTools Protocol injection so reactive fields never drop or cross-wire data.
caption: the grimoire, mid-incantation ✨
codeBlock:
Title: Dunmoor Valley
Keywords: region, valley, Millstone Valley

Title: Fria
Keywords: Queen of Chaos, protagonist
Content: The main character...
stack: How to install
1. Download the .zip and extract it somewhere safe (Desktop or Documents)
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON (top right)
4. Click Load unpacked → select the extracted clank-lorebook-importer folder
5. Done — open your Lorebook on clank.world; the UI appears bottom-right
Built with
manifest.json — Manifest V3, CDP debugger permission
background.js — OS-level Input.insertText + coordinate clicks via CDP
content.js — drop-zone parser, field traversal, save confirmation
Adjustable ritual pace + emergency STOP RITUAL kill switch
hint: Extract → brave://extensions or chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked

name: Obelisk: Clank Layout Builder
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3
desc: A visual layout and component builder for Clank.world character profiles. Obelisk adds a 47-tool studio directly to the Character Edit page, letting creators build styled sections, character UI, lore blocks, media embeds, fake widgets, interactive components and more through configurable live previews — then insert the finished result straight into the About editor.
caption: Obelisk 2.0, fully booted ✦
codeBlock: [ OBELISK ENGINE ONLINE ] // EDIT MODE DETECTED
stack: How to install
1. Download the .zip and extract it somewhere safe (Desktop or Documents)
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON (top right)
4. Click Load unpacked → select the extracted clank-layout-builder folder
5. Done — open any Character Edit page on clank.world and Obelisk will appear
What is inside
47 tools covering layouts, character presentation, lore, themed text, media, social/profile components and interactive widgets
Live previews for customizing components before inserting them into the profile
Search, Favorites, Recently Used tools, accent customization and persistent settings
Interactive tools including Spinning Photo Plane and Interactive Hotspot Image
Media tools including SoundCloud, Sketchfab, cinematic GIFs, tracklists and holographic cards
Obelisk 2.0 rebuild
content.js is now a small application bootstrap instead of containing the entire extension
Core systems are separated into storage, modal, fonts, controllers, panel UI and metadata modules
All 47 tools are organized into dedicated tool groups for easier maintenance and future additions
Legacy Photo Plane support remains available for older Obelisk-generated components
hint: Extract → brave://extensions or chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked

name: Furina: Clank Chat Atelier
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3 · Clank.world chat customization
desc: A client-side chat customization and roleplay toolkit for clank.world. Furina turns the chat page into a personal atelier with per-conversation themes, live MP4/WebM wallpapers, styled message bubbles and typography, stickers, atmosphere, music, Reader/Focus tools, visual effects, import/export, scoped custom CSS, and persistent Director Notes that can keep user-defined RP rules and continuity reminders in active context while hiding Furina's generated reminder block from the local transcript.

chrome://extensions
Developer mode → ON
Load unpacked → select the extracted Furina folder
stack: How to install
1. Download Furina-Clank-Chat-Atelier-1.0.0.zip and extract it somewhere you plan to keep it
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON
4. Click Load unpacked and select the extracted Furina folder
5. Open a chat on clank.world — Furina's launcher will appear on supported chat routes
Look & themes
Global or per-conversation themes with solid, gradient, image and direct MP4/WebM video backgrounds
Separate assistant/user bubbles, glass effects, textures, borders, shadows, typography, avatar frames and color grading
Animated gradients, edge glow, message entrance effects, particles, corner ornaments, separators and other optional cosmetic layers
Scene & immersion
Draggable/resizable stickers with layouts and a sticker library
Atmosphere effects, direct audio/SoundCloud ambience, Reader/Focus presentation tools and screenshot-friendly viewing
Director Notes / RP control
Per-conversation persistent RP rules and continuity notes can be attached to normal outgoing messages as explicit ooc: guidance
Furina hides only its own uniquely marked generated Director block from the local transcript; ordinary user-written OOC remains visible
Director Notes are reminders, not backend memory edits, and cannot guarantee model compliance
Sharing & advanced tools
Theme presets, theme import/export, Full Setup portability, diagnostics and scoped Advanced CSS
